name: VISIBLE SPECTROPHOTOMETER
desc: Benchtop Digital Visible Spectrophotometer engineered for routine photometric analysis, quantitative chemical assays, and quality control processing. Features a compact, highly portable single beam optical layout optimized for the visible spectrum range with a built-in USB data output port.
features: High-stability Single Beam optical topology pathway
Quantitative tracking of Transmittance (%T), Absorbance (A), and Concentration (C)
High-Visibility integrated Digital Display dashboard panel
Built-in high-speed USB Interface Port for direct computer alignment
Highly compact, lightweight, and Portable benchtop configuration
